  AI Review Summary: Discrete Diffusion VLA(dVLA)의 K-step masked denoising 과정을 Markov chain으로 unroll하여 intractable한 marginal action probability 대신 **denoising trajectory의 joint probability**를 PPO objective로 직접 최적화함으로써, native dVLA에 최초로 RL을 적용하고 LIBERO 99.7% SoTA + RoboTwin 2.0 VLA-기반 SoTA(SFT 대비 +30.6pt)를 달성한 프레임워크.
  AI Review: PDF-verified

  AI Review: PDF-verified

  AI Review Summary: Latent action을 결정론적 "점"이 아니라 **대각 가우시안 분포**(mean + dimension-wise variance)로 표현하고, 등간격 triplet에 대해 **normalized composition**과 **reversal** 제약을 평균과 분산 모두에 부과. 인접 transition이 중간 프레임을 공유하는 의존성은 **학습된 공유 상관계수 ρ**로 처리. 다운스트림에서는 encoder를 freeze하고 **posterior mean만** π0의 joint flow matching 보조 타깃으로 전달 → M
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: BCP
  Organization: Peking University, Microsoft Research Asia
  Date: 2026-08-04
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03483
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Bernoulli-Continuation Head: a lightweight 2-layer Transformer encoder attached to a frozen chunk-based VLA. It consumes VLA-derived visual-language tokens F_t, the denoised action a_t^j and the final-step action-velocity feature u_t^j for each action step, projects them into a shared d-dim space with a prepended [CLS] token, and outputs M-1 logits mapped by sigmoid to continue probabilities p_t^i. Execution-horizon selection is factorized as an ordered chain of continue-or-replan Bernoulli decisions: pi(E_t = e_k) = (prod_{i<k} p_t^i)(1 - p_t^k). The base VLA still generates all actions; BCP only decides how many actions of the chunk to execute before replanning. Candidate horizons E = (15, 20, 25, ..., 50).
    Backbone: Frozen base VLA (LingBot-VLA w/o depth, ABot-M0, ACT on RoboTwin 2.0; pi0.5 on LIBERO); BCP adds only a 2-layer Transformer encoder head
    LLM: None
    Parameters: 16.393M trainable (continuation head only; base VLA frozen)
  Tags: adaptive-horizon, action-chunking, replanning, reinforcement-learning, GRPO, plug-and-play, frozen-backbone, libero, robotwin, libero-pro, real-robot
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=98.7): libero_spatial=99.6, libero_object=99.8, libero_goal=99.2, libero_long=96.2, libero_avg=98.7
    robotwin_v2 (avg=93.94): robotwin_v2_avg=93.94, robotwin_v2_50task_clean=93.94, robotwin_v2_50task_randomized=92.84, robotwin_v2_13_lowsuccess_clean=86.23, robotwin_v2_13_lowsuccess_randomized=83.46
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'pi0.5 base (prediction horizon 10, candidate execution horizons {2,4,5,6,8,10}), 4 suites, BCP head trained with GRPO; LIBERO-PRO evaluated on Object suite with position perturbation magnitudes x0.2/x0.3/x0.4 following the AAC protocol', 'robotwin_v2': 'LingBot-VLA w/o depth base, prediction and execution horizon 50 by default, candidate horizons (15,20,...,50); trained on Clean, evaluated on Clean and Randomized', 'real_world': 'AGIBOT G1, 50 seeds x 3 trials per task. MODEL: AtVLA
  Organization: Xi'an Jiaotong University
  Date: 2026-08-03
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02197
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: 300M-parameter flow-matching action expert inherited unchanged from pi0 (10-step Euler ODE solver). At each replanning step the expert samples K=4 action chunks from independent Gaussian initializations over a shared prefix KV cache; uncertainty U_t is the mean per-step standard deviation across samples over the translational dimensions {dx, dy, dz} of the first h executed actions. If U_t <= tau the mean chunk is executed; otherwise attention-guided cropping runs and the expert is re-run once on the extended prefix.
    Backbone: PaliGemma 3B (SigLIP-So400m visual encoder + Gemma-2B language backbone), initialized from a pretrained pi0 checkpoint. Inputs are 224x224 images with patch size 14, giving 256 patch tokens per view; four learnable 1152-dim register embeddings are inserted immediately after the CLS token (only 4,608 extra parameters). Register outputs are NOT discarded but projected through the PaliGemma visual projector and exposed to the policy as multi-slot global embodied context, while the full 16x16 patch grid stays available for spatial grounding.
    LLM: Gemma-2B (inside PaliGemma); base weights frozen, rank-32 LoRA adapters trainable in the final stage
    Parameters: 3.3B (3B PaliGemma + 300M action expert; +4,608 register params, crop-position MLP 4->256->d_LLM, rank-32 LoRA)
  Tags: libero, simpler-env, real-world, pi0, flow-matching, register-tokens, attention-artifacts, attention-rollout, uncertainty-gating, adaptive-cropping, visual-refinement, siglip, paligemma, lora, franka
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=98.38): libero_spatial=99.3, libero_object=99.4, libero_goal=98.3, libero_long=96.5
    simpler_env: google_robot_pick_coke_can=91.3, google_robot_move_near=81.6, google_robot_open_close_drawer=57.5
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned; pi0 (PaliGemma 3B + 300M flow-matching action expert), post-trained with registers + uncertainty-gated cropping; note: A single unified policy is trained on the mixture of all four suites (2,000 trajectories). AtVLA lifts the pi0 baseline average from 94.2% to 98.4% and beats every listed baseline on all four suites, including VLANeXt (99.0/99.2/96.6/94.8) and pi0.5. Controlled ablations from the same initialization and data: pi0+Registers 98.8/99.0/98.0/93.1, pi0+Cropping (crops from an external VLM without embodied pre-training) 96.5/98.2/96.7/93.3. Removing the learned registers from pi0+Registers drops all four suites to 93.2/92.1/92.2/81.3, i.e. -4.45 average task-level change, showing the registers store embodied knowledge rather than merely suppressing artifacts. Register capacity saturates at four; fewer registers can fall below the pi0 baseline due to incomplete artifact absorption.', 'simpler_env': 'fine-tuned; pi0 checkpoint, Google Robot embodiment with its own calibrated uncertainty threshold; note: AtVLA leads on Pick Coke Can (91.3 vs pi0 88.0) and Move Near (81.6 vs 80.3) but is only competitive on Open/Close Drawer (57.5 vs pi0 56.0, RT-1-X 59.7). Custom single-view benchmark with two suites — Kitchen (Move/Grab/Pick/Long/Spatial) and Building Blocks (Stack/Edge/Spatial/Long/Grab), 20 independent experiments per cell. AtVLA scores 80/65/80/40/75 and 80/50/70/35/70 versus pi0 at 50/35/55/15/75 and 55/25/55/15/35, raising average real-world success from 46.5% to 69.0%. Largest gains are on grasping and small-object stacking, where single-view depth ambiguity hurts most.', 'inference_cost': 'deployment; note: C_AtVLA = N(C_base + K*C_A + r*(C_crop + C_A)) versus C_pi0 = N(C_base + C_A). With K=4 and trigger rate r ~ 0.3, and one expert pass / crop refinement costing ~10-15% / ~20-25% of a full pi0 replanning pass, total computation is ~1.4-1.6x pi0. Attention rollout itself is nearly free because it reuses attention already computed during action sampling, and the base prefix KV cache is reused when crop tokens are appended. The gate is evaluated once per action-chunk replanning step, not per low-level control step. The threshold is calibrated per embodiment (shared across the four LIBERO suites; separate for Google Robot and Franka), initialized at the 70th percentile of the validation uncertainty distribution under a 30% trigger-rate budget.'}
  AI Review Summary: VLA의 시각 인코더도 ViT의 high-norm attention artifact를 앓고 있으며, embodied post-training이 그걸 **악화시킨다**는 진단에서 출발한다. 해법은 두 개. (a) SigLIP에 학습 가능한 **register token 4개**를 꽂아 넘치는 global 정보를 흡수시키고 patch attention을 정화하며, 그 register 출력을 버리지 않고 policy에 **embodied spatial context로 재활용**. (b) action expert가 K=4개 청크를 뽑아 *
  AI Review: PDF-verified

    Action Head: Fourier Feature Action Decoder (FFAD): 33M-parameter adapter on top of the UND expert. <|action_pred|> anchor tokens are appended to the autoregressive sequence (H tokens for horizon H); each hidden state is projected to d_r=1024, refined by a 2-layer Transformer encoder (4 heads, FFN 4*d_r), then a 2-block residual MLP head predicts actions as Fourier features (K=32 bands, l2 regression), reconstructed deterministically via phase-consistent atan2 averaging. RL-tuned with Flow-GSPO (SDE reformulation via Fokker-Planck + Group Segmented PO; G=8 group size, β=0.01 KL).
    Backbone: SigLIP (semantic) + VGGT (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer, spatial)
    LLM: PaLiGemma (decoder-only Transformer; weights pretrained)
    Parameters: not stated in paper
  Tags: RL, online-RL, flow-matching, mixture-of-experts, spatial-understanding, libero
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=97.6): libero_spatial=99.2, libero_object=99.2, libero_goal=98.5, libero_long=93.5
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'SFT + online RL (Flow-GSPO) fine-tuned'}
  AI Review Summary: Reasoning/spatial/action 전문가를 Mix-of-Transformers로 통합하고, flow matching을 SDE로 재정식화한 Flow-GSPO를 GSPO와 결합하여 VLA의 공간 이해와 online RL 안정성을 동시에 끌어올리려는 시도.

MODEL: CoTinyVLA
  Organization: Chung-Ang University
  Date: 2026-07-28
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25487
  Code: https://github.com/BrainJellyPie/CoTinyVLA
  Venue: None
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Action head reads the final hidden state at a fixed query position, after the generated reasoning span, and regresses an 8-step 7-DoF action chunk (6 end-effector deltas plus gripper) in one forward pass, trained with an L1 loss. A ~1M-parameter two-layer MLP projects the 8-dim proprioception vector into a single soft token. Reasoning tokens are produced autoregressively, but the actions themselves are regressed, not tokenized.
    Backbone: Qwen3.5-0.8B vision-language backbone; images encoded at 224x224, 8 third-person plus 8 wrist frames per control step, each preceded by an explicit textual marker ([Third frame i] / [Wrist frame i]) so temporal and camera indices live in the token stream instead of extra positional embeddings
    LLM: Qwen3.5-0.8B (same backbone serves as the language model; four added control tokens <plan>, </plan>, <think>, </think>)
    Parameters: 0.9B
  Tags: libero, libero-plus, chain-of-thought, distillation, sub-1b, lightweight, efficient, robustness, action-chunking, qwen3.5, dual-view, temporal-history, paraphrase-augmentation, open-source

Rollout caps follow the OpenVLA-OFT family: 220 steps on Spatial, 280 on Object, 300 on Goal, 520 on Long. The 97.5% average matches the strongest 7B baseline (RIPT-VLA 97.5%) and is 2.7 points above the strongest sub-1B baseline (Evo-1 94.8%). Closed-loop inference on an L40S: 1.37 s median steady-state step per 8-step chunk, 2.25 GiB peak allocated memory, greedy decoding with a 120-token reasoning budget.; libero_plus_note: The paper's headline result is on LIBERO-Plus (10,030 perturbed tasks, seven perturbation dimensions, one rollout per task), which is not a tracked benchmark here.   Date: 2026-06-10

  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Voxel heatmap action head: pure-MLP trunk with residual connections, branches into three parallel MLPs producing (i) translation voxel heatmap (48x48x24 grid), (ii) rotation voxel heatmap over Euler angles (24x24x24 grid), and (iii) gripper open/close binary distribution.     Parameters: ~7B (OpenVLA-OFT backbone); heatmap head is a lightweight MLP that replaces the native L1 regression or flow-matching decoder

MODEL: DyGRO-VLA
  Organization: Affiliations from Shenzhen and Guangdong institutions (specific institutions not enumerated in arXiv abstract page; authors: Sixu Lin, Yunpeng Qing, Litao Liu, Ming Zhou, Ruixing Jin, Xiaoyi Fan, Guiliang Liu)
  Date: 2026-05-17
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17486
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Two-stage cross-task RL framework. Stage 1 (offline pre-training): Information Bottleneck objective max I(Z;A) - lambda_IB * I(Z;O), implemented via variational lower bound L_base = E[-log pi(a|z)] + lambda_IB * MINE-style term. Stage 2 (online fine-tuning): Mixture-of-RL-Residuals (MoRR) — Delta_a = sum omega_i(z_T) * a_tilde_i, with routing omega over expert residual policies guided by task embeddings learned via contrastive loss. RL optimizer is a Soft Actor-Critic variant with h-step action chunking.
    Backbone: DINOv2 vision encoder + SigLIP language model + Qwen2.5-0.5B LLM

MODEL: FiberTune
  Organization: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Hebei Key Laboratory of Cognitive Intelligence (Xiong'an Institute of Innovation); Hebei University of Technology; Beijing Information Science and Technology University
  Date: 2026-06-07
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08653
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Inherited from each base VLA: pi0.5 uses a flow-matching action expert; OpenVLA-OFT uses optimized fine-tuned heads (parallel decoding + L1 regression). FiberTune does NOT modify the action head; it adds (a) an online linear action probe on detached pooled visual tokens, (b) a fixed randomly initialized per-token MLP adapter (hidden width 2048) into a frozen RADIO c-radio v3-l teacher feature space, and (c) two training-time auxiliary losses (probe-filtered residual cosine alignment Lalign + spectral-entropy effective-rank prior Lrank). All FiberTune machinery is removed at inference.
    Backbone: pi0.5 (PaliGemma-family VLA) and OpenVLA-OFT (OpenVLA-7B + flow-matching head); FiberTune is a training-time auxiliary applied on top of these existing VLA backbones
    LLM: PaliGemma2 (within pi0.5) / Llama-2-7B (within OpenVLA)
    Parameters: no inference-time parameter change vs base VLA (pi0.5 ~3B / OpenVLA-OFT ~7B). Training-only adds a linear probe + 2048-hidden MLP adapter that are discarded at deployment.
  Tags: vla, fine-tuning, representation-preservation, residual-alignment, frozen-teacher, radio, action-fiber, effective-rank, calvin, libero, so-101, pi0.5, openvla-oft
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=97.1): libero_spatial=97.8, libero_object=98.8, libero_goal=97.8, libero_long=94.0, libero_avg=97.1

MODEL: StableVLA
  Organization: Peking University, Tsinghua University, Astribot, Nanjing University, Nankai University
  Date: 2026-05-18

  Venue: ICML 2026
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Fused Information Bottleneck Adapter (Fused IB-Adapter) on top of a Prismatic-style VLA. MODEL: CloudEdgeVLA
  Organization: HKUST(GZ) / Shandong University / RoboScience
  Date: 2026-08-01
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00569
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint (AAAI 2027 format)
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Vision-Augmented Action Head (edge-side, lightweight, replaces the original OFT L1 regression head). Mean-pools the possibly stale cloud planning features over the action-dimension axis to get per-timestep planning embeddings, projects the current edge vision features into the same latent space, concatenates them, and passes the result through a residual MLP to predict a continuous action chunk of shape T x A. Trained with paired-frame dual-path L1 loss: L = (1-lambda)*||a_fresh - a_t||_1 + lambda*||a_stale - a_t||_1, where the stale path uses a randomly delayed frame o_{t-d}, d ~ Uniform(1, W-1), fused with the same current vision features z_t; lambda is curriculum-warmed from 0 to lambda_max. Gradients flow through both paths into the backbone, inducing emergent representational specialization rather than an explicit invariance loss
    Backbone: Cloud-side System 2: OpenVLA-OFT 7B backbone (Prismatic VLM, SigLIP + DINOv2 vision, LoRA-adapted) producing planning features h = f(o, l) in R^{LxD} with L = T x A action-token positions. Edge-side System 1 perception: frozen SigLIP-Base local vision encoder computing z_t from the current observation
    LLM: Llama-2 7B (inherited from OpenVLA / OpenVLA-OFT), LoRA-adapted, runs exclusively on the cloud server
    Parameters: 7B cloud backbone (LoRA-adapted) + lightweight edge stack (frozen SigLIP-Base encoder + residual-MLP action head)
  Tags: 7B, cloud-edge, latency-tolerant, asynchronous-inference, dual-system, delay-robustness, action-chunking, LoRA, openvla-oft, siglip, libero, manipulation
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=95.97): libero_spatial=97.9, libero_object=97.8, libero_goal=96.5, libero_long=91.7, libero_avg=95.98, libero_spatial_delay10=93.6, libero_object_delay10=94.4, libero_goal_delay10=92.9, libero_long_delay10=83.2, libero_spatial_delay20=89.6, libero_object_delay20=92.1, libero_goal_delay20=90.9, libero_long_delay20=78.1, libero_spatial_delay40=76.4, libero_object_delay40=75.6, libero_goal_delay40=78.0, libero_long_delay40=63.8, macro_avg_delay40=73.5, normalized_delay_auc=90.8, retention_at_delay40=76.5
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'Four LIBERO suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, Long), 10 tasks each, 50 trials per task, three random seeds (7, 8, 9). Synchronous reference (d_max=0) plus a uniform-delay sweep up to 40 steps', 'baselines': 'Single-path OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT and UniVLA (delayed frames fed without changing their inference paths), plus future-state-aware asynchronous VLASH on the same uniform-delay grid', 'ablation': 'Aggregate success at d_max=10: no vision encoder (stale h only) 31.6, SigLIP-Base frozen (default) 95.1, SigLIP-SO400M frozen 95.8, L_fresh only 54.8, L_stale only 89.2, L_fresh + L_stale 95.1', 'real_robot': 'Franka pick-and-place pilot (place a toy bear in a box), static and dynamic variants (target displaced within 10 cm during reaching), 10 trials per cell, emulated added RTT of 0 / 400 / 1000 ms on top of native serving latency. CloudEdgeVLA 100/90, 90/90, 80/70 vs VLASH 100/90, 60/30, 0/0', 'mechanism_diagnostic': "Offline fixed-offset diagnostics on LIBERO-Spatial over 80 shared demonstration states vs the original OpenVLA-OFT checkpoint. At d=20 CloudEdgeVLA reduces backbone hidden-state drift D_h by 59.2% (0.391 -> 0.160), staleness transfer gain kappa by 72.7% (1.082 -> 0.295), action drift D_a by 88.9% (0.423 -> 0.047) and demonstration MAE by 88.5% (0.421 -> 0.048). Counterfactual audit: switching the edge input from equally stale to current at d_h=20 changes mean action drift only from 0.047104 to 0.047097 (edge-rescue fraction 0.03%), so this checkpoint's gain is attributed mainly to backbone stability and head attenuation rather than direct edge correction"}
  AI Review Summary: 클라우드-엣지 VLA의 시간 어긋남(temporal misalignment)을 **스케줄링 문제가 아니라 표현 학습 문제**로 재정의한다. 클라우드 7B 백본은 지연된 관측으로부터 **천천히 변하는 task feature**를 만들고, 엣지의 경량 **Vision-Augmented Action Head**가 가장 최근에 도착한 클라우드 feature와 **현재** 로컬 시각을 융합해 행동을 낸다. 학습 시 현재 프레임과 무작위 지연 프레임을 **같은 현재 행동 타깃**으로 짝지어 supervise(paired-frame dual-p
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: LoopVLA
  Organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST), Wuhan United Imaging Surgical Co., Ltd.
  Date: 2026-05-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09948
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Recurrent refinement: first 4 transformer layers (Perceptual Anchor Layers, PAL) are frozen, then a shared 3-layer Loop Block is applied iteratively (up to 8 iterations) on multimodal tokens. Each iteration produces (a) a candidate action via the action head and (b) a halting probability via the sufficiency head. Remaining Mass Allocation (RMA) converts halting scores into a valid distribution p(n) = s(n)*r(n) over refinement steps. Two-stage training: Stage 1 supervises all intermediates with L1 + entropy/diversity regularization; Stage 2 calibrates halting distribution to action-quality-derived target via KL divergence.
    Backbone: Qwen3VL-2B-Instruction (SigLIP-2 visual encoder + 28-layer transformer decoder)
    LLM: None
    Parameters: LoopOFT*: 1.2B (vs 2.2B Qwen3OFT baseline, -45%); LoopFM: 1.3B (vs 2.3B Qwen3FM, -43%)
  Tags: libero, libero-plus, vla-arena, recurrent, sufficiency, early-exit, efficiency, qwen3-vl
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=95.85): libero_spatial=95.0, libero_object=100.0, libero_goal=97.4, libero_long=91.0, libero_avg=95.85, libero_plus_avg=65.8, libero_plus_camera=58.3, libero_plus_robot=41.7, libero_plus_language=66.7, libero_plus_light=88.9, libero_plus_background=88.3
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned', 'libero_plus': 'zero-shot generalization (camera/robot/language/light/background factors)', 'vla_arena': 'fine-tuned; L0 (safety/distractor/extrapolation/long-horizon)'}
  AI Review Summary: "VLA backbone의 가장 깊은 표현이 항상 최적"이라는 통념을 정면 반박. 4 frozen Perceptual Anchor Layer 위에 3-layer shared Loop Block을 최대 8회 반복 적용하면서, 매 iteration마다 후보 action + sufficiency score를 산출. Remaining Mass Allocation(RMA)과 self-supervised distribution alignment로 "언제 멈출지"를 학습. Qwen3VL-2B에서 파라미터 -45%(2.2B→1.2B) + 처리량 
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: Cross-View Action-Flow Consistency
  Organization: Tsinghua University; University of Amsterdam; Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
  Date: 2026-08-07
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06965
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Flow-matching action expert (pi0.5 action expert). Training adds a cross-view consistency term L_CV that forces the predicted action-flow velocity v_theta(x_t, t | o, l, q) of a nominal and a perturbed scene-camera view of the SAME MuJoCo state to agree at the same sampled flow coordinate (t_k, eps_k), on the active action dims (A_act = 7). Final recipe: bilateral gradients, K=2 flow samples per pair, lambda_CV = 0.10, t ~ Beta(2,3), pair-consistent spatial augmentation. Inference is unchanged: single scene RGB + language + proprioception.
    Backbone: pi0.5-style vision-language trunk (fine-tuned from the open-sourced pi0.5 checkpoint)
    LLM: pi0.5 VLM trunk (PaliGemma-style)
    Parameters: unknown
  Tags: flow_matching, camera_robustness, viewpoint_invariance, cross_view_consistency, multi_view_supervision, training_objective, libero, libero_plus, pi0_5, real_robot

MODEL: Mind-VLA
  Organization: Nanjing University / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
  Date: 2026-08-05
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04633
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Diffusion transformer (DiT) action head conditioned on the final-layer action-query outputs; trained with epsilon-prediction MSE over a chunk of Ta future 7-D actions (paper reports predicting the next three actions), sampled with DDIM at inference
    Backbone: Causal transformer over a context window of K timesteps. Inputs at each step: two 224x224x3 RGB images (primary + wrist camera) encoded by a frozen vision encoder, an 8-D proprioceptive state via linear projection, and the language instruction via a frozen CLIP text encoder. Three groups of learnable queries are appended to the sequence (scene-level, object-level, action-level) and separated by a query-group attention mask that also enforces temporal causality
    LLM: None (frozen CLIP text encoder used for language conditioning; no autoregressive LLM)
    Parameters: 345M
  Tags: libero, calvin, diffusion, instruction_aware, spatial_alignment, representation_alignment, 3d_aware, vggt, vae_latent_prediction, tri_view, auxiliary_supervision, compact_backbone, occlusion_robustness, real_robot

  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned per suite after LIBERO-90 pre-training; 20 rollouts per task', 'calvin': 'ABC->D generalization on held-out environment D; 1000 rollouts, average completed length over 5 chained instructions'}
  AI Review Summary: 기존 3D-aware VLA의 정렬 타깃이 "장면 전체"라서 instruction-agnostic하다는 점을 지적하고, 지시문이 지목한 **타깃 물체의 tri-view(top/front/side)** 를 VAE latent 예측 + 4-layer VGGT feature 정렬로 학습 시에만 감독하는 방법. 345M 백본으로 LIBERO 93.9%, CALVIN ABC-D 4.47을 달성하고, 실로봇 25% 가림 조건에서 성능 하락이 13pp에 그친다(scene-image 정렬 ablation은 29pp 붕괴).

MODEL: ActFovea
  Organization: Tongji University / MBZUAI / Shanghai AI Laboratory / UESTC
  Date: 2026-07-31
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29169
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Plug-and-play runtime safeguarding loop (not a new action head). Four stages over the frozen policy: (1) action-conditioned foveation that builds an interaction-centered preserve mask from forward kinematics, proprioception and previous actions (contact disk + projected motion corridor, dilated by a safety margin) and desensitizes the editable background; (2) a spatiotemporal consistency monitor fusing geometric, dynamic, temporal (timestamp health, lag, replay similarity) and action-proprioception agreement into a risk score R_t, with a deterministic router that infers disturbance type and recoverability; (3) a disturbance-conditioned candidate observation bank (raw, foveated, temporally stabilized, overlay-deblended via estimated pattern/alpha) whose induced action chunks are verified by a fixed weighted score over first-action direction, endpoint direction, magnitude, smoothness, horizon and chunk drift; (4) risk-adaptive execution with two-stage arbitration (motion scale, shortened horizon, servo recovery) and a bounded safe-failure / hold-latch path when observations are stale or replayed
    Backbone: Wraps a frozen VLA policy through its observation-action interface; evaluated on the LIBERO checkpoint of pi0 (PaliGemma-based VLM + flow-matching action expert). No retraining or parameter modification of the underlying policy
    LLM: Inherited from the wrapped VLA (Gemma / PaliGemma for pi0)
    Parameters: 0 added trainable parameters (frozen pi0 checkpoint; all router/verifier weights and thresholds are fixed implementation constants)
  Tags: inference_time, runtime_safeguard, safety, robustness, training_free, wrapper, foveation, action_chunk_verification, consistency_monitoring, safe_failure, pi0, libero
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=93.8): libero_avg=93.8, undisturbed_sr=93.8, base_vla_undisturbed_sr=93.0, visual_overlay_sr=90.3, visual_overlay_base_sr=49.3, visual_overlay_nrr=93.7, visual_delay_sr=86.0, visual_delay_base_sr=76.2, visual_delay_nrr=59.8, action_drift_sr=90.1, action_drift_base_sr=83.1, action_drift_nrr=73.1, frozen_replay_timely_safe_failure_pct=100.0, frozen_replay_unprotected_failure_pct=0.0
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'Plug-and-play inference-time safeguard over frozen pi0 on four LIBERO suites (40 tasks, 50 episodes each); disturbance labels and generator parameters are not exposed to ActFovea', 'disturbances': 'Persistent localized visual overlay (alpha-blended checker pattern after a clean warm-up), multi-view visual feedback delay (exterior + wrist held 3 frames behind proprioception), smooth action-chunk drift (phase-conditioned perturbation of chunk motion dimensions before verification), and frozen-observation replay (trigger frame reused in both views until termination)', 'baselines': 'Training-free runtime comparisons: Action Clip/Smoothing, Fixed Short Horizon, Timestamp-Only Hold; ActFovea is the only method preserving undisturbed performance while improving all three recoverable disturbances'}
  AI Review Summary: 재학습이나 파라미터 수정 없이 frozen VLA 정책의 **관측-행동 인터페이스** 위에서 동작하는 plug-and-play **런타임 안전장치(runtime safeguard)**. 로봇 kinematics·proprioception·최근 행동으로 **행동 조건부 foveation** 영역을 만들고, 시공간 visual-action 일관성으로 위험을 탐지하며, 복구 가능한 교란에는 후보 관측을 재구성해 **유도된 action chunk를 검증한 뒤에만** 실행하고, 복구가 불가능하면 **경계된 safe-failure**로 전환한
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: CLAP
  Organization: OMRON SINIC X Corp. (with Ochanomizu University, University of Tokyo)
  Date: 2026-07-09
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08974
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Autoregressive discrete action tokens with a language-action prefix (Causal Language-Action Prediction). Each 7-DoF action dimension is discretized into K=1000 integer bins and emitted as text tokens using the VLM's existing vocabulary. Before the numeric action tokens, the model autoregressively generates a natural-language action description (e.g. 'move forward 3 cm, tilt right 1 degree, close gripper') wrapped in <think>...</think>, deterministically produced during training from the ground-truth action chunk via a fixed template. Causal attention conditions the numeric tokens on the preceding language prefix. No action expert, no vocabulary extension, no architectural change; standard next-token cross-entropy loss for both language and action tokens.
    Backbone: Qwen3.5 VLM
    LLM: Qwen3.5 (0.8B / 2B / 4B)
    Parameters: 0.8B/2B/4B
  Inference: 1.86 Hz
  Tags: libero, libero-pro, vlabench, autoregressive, compact-vla, vlm-to-vla, language-grounding, qwen3.5, open-source, real-world
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=90.8): libero_spatial=93.0, libero_object=97.4, libero_goal=90.8, libero_long=82.0, libero_avg=90.8
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned (single epoch, full-parameter, h=8); matched-protocol reproduction vs VLA-0; Qwen3.5-2B, unmasked', 'real_world': 'UR5e pick-and-place, 120 demos, 20 trials/condition; 2B ID/OOD 60%, 0.8B ID 35%/OOD 10%'}
  AI Review Summary: 사전학습 VLM을 아키텍처 변경 없이 VLA로 직접 변환할 때 발생하는 "출력 분포 불일치"를, 숫자 action token 앞에 템플릿 기반 자연어 action 설명을 붙여 causal하게 조건화함으로써 해결한다. 단일 epoch 파인튜닝만으로 2B CLAP이 LIBERO 90.8%(VLA-0 대비 +14.9pt)를 달성하고 0.8B/2B/4B open-weight 계열을 공개한다.

  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint

  Architecture:
    Action Head: Inference-time backdoor defense wrapper (not a new action head). Three separated modules over the frozen VLA: (1) trusted-evidence uncertainty monitor that adapts the Dirichlet evidence framework to per-token, per-layer epistemic-uncertainty trajectories via the LM head, flagging observations that leave the clean-calibrated evidence-evolution region; (2) counterfactual support localization that seeds candidate compact supports from decision-layer attention rank-promotion and validates them by a mechanism-score drop under temporary masking (compact causal footprint, |S| <= B = 16 image tokens ~6% of the visual grid); (3) localized inpainting recovery that erases the validated support and inpaints before the next action query, with fail-safe when no support validates
    Backbone: Wraps a frozen open-source VLA checkpoint at inference time (evaluated on OpenVLA; SigLIP/DINOv2 vision + LLaMA-2 backbone) and cross-architecture on pi0.5 (PaliGemma) transfer; no retraining of the underlying policy
    LLM: Inherited from the wrapped VLA (LLaMA-2 for OpenVLA; Gemma for pi0.5)
    Parameters: 0 added trainable params (frozen checkpoint; only a small clean calibration set is used to freeze thresholds)
  Tags: inference_time, backdoor_defense, security, retraining_free, dirichlet_evidence, epistemic_uncertainty, attention_analysis, counterfactual_localization, inpainting, openvla, pi0.5, libero, wrapper

MODEL: ProbeAct
  Organization: University of California Los Angeles
  Date: 2026-06-08
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09740
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Inherits OpenVLA-OFT L1-regression action head; ProbeAct applies a hierarchical Control Barrier Function (CBF) filter as a closed-form minimal-intervention quadratic program on the nominal translational action u_vla in R^3 during PreGrasp phase only (filter bypassed during Grasping/Transporting). Filter form: u_filtered = u_vla + max(0, (-gamma*h(x) - grad_h(x)^T * u_vla) / ||grad_h(x)||^2) * grad_h(x), with h(x; c, r_safe) = ||x - c||^2 - r_safe^2 instantiated dynamically only on repeated-failure coordinates.
    Backbone: OpenVLA-OFT (7B, LLaMA-7B backbone) treated as frozen black-box policy; ProbeAct is a training-free inference-time wrapper that neither modifies VLA weights nor requires additional demonstrations
    LLM: LLaMA-7B (inherited from OpenVLA-OFT)
    Parameters: Base VLA weights frozen (7B); only a 4-layer MLP probe is trained (hidden dims [2048, 1024, 512, 256], input d_pca=1024 from PCA on 4x4-pooled layer-8 spatial tokens, output K x 3 positions + K confidences with sigmoid)
  Tags: vla, failure-recovery, training-free, inference-time, hidden-state-probing, control-barrier-function, cbf, safety-filter, openvla-wrapper, openvla-oft-base, libero, libero-plus, kinematic-state-machine, hungarian-matching, probe-guided, closed-loop-recovery
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=74.1): libero_plus_camera=63.8, libero_plus_robot=40.3, libero_plus_language=82.0, libero_plus_light=93.6, libero_plus_background=93.5, libero_plus_noise=76.8, libero_plus_layout=80.9, libero_plus_total=74.1, libero_avg=74.1

MODEL: JEPA-VLA-VICReg
  Organization: Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology (Skoltech)
  Date: 2026-06-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13856
  Code: None
  Venue: CoRL 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: 16-layer Diffusion Transformer (DiT) action head trained via straight-path flow matching, H=7 action chunk horizon, 7-DoF (delta-EE position + rotation + gripper). Companion ACPredictor (12-layer Transformer, RoPE, dmodel=1024) predicts future V-JEPA2 patch embeddings z_T as a world-model loss (Lwm = L1 to stop-gradient targets). Patch-level VICReg variance + covariance regularization is applied on the predicted latents z_hat (N=768 spatial-temporal patches treated as the sample axis), allowing B=1 stable training. Dropout p=0.1 is applied to ACPredictor and FlowMatchingActionHead in the Dropout variant; LowLR variant halves both learning rates (5e-6, 1.5e-5) with no other changes.
    Backbone: V-JEPA2 ViT-L/16 video encoder (frozen, T=4-8 frames, P=256 patches, D=2048) + Qwen3-VL-2B as VLM (frozen, eager attention). Both backbones are kept frozen on single-RTX-5090 hardware -- the structural condition that makes the seed lottery emergent.
    LLM: Qwen3-VL-2B (frozen)
    Parameters: Trainable: ACPredictor (12-layer Transformer, dmodel=1024) + FlowMatching ActionHead (16-layer DiT) only. Frozen: V-JEPA2 ViT-L/16 + Qwen3-VL-2B. Total frozen-backbone footprint dominates parameter count; trainable portion remains in the small-VLA regime suitable for single-GPU fine-tuning.

MODEL: WA-SpecDec
  Organization: The University of Sydney
  Date: 2026-08-09
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08725
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Autoregressive discrete action-token decoding of the target VLA, accelerated by speculative decoding: a distilled lightweight draft model proposes gamma tokens from the shared world-aware prefill hidden states and the world-aware target verifies them in parallel under an unchanged relaxed acceptance rule (rho-based, KERV, or HeiSD).
    Backbone: Frozen VLA visual backbone + multimodal projector (OpenVLA primary target; ActionCodec and UniVLA also evaluated as targets). Frozen Wan 2.2 VAE encoder used only as a latent compressor for the World-Aware Bias path.
    LLM: Target VLA language model with trainable LoRA adapters (base VLA parameters frozen)
    Parameters: Not reported; trainable parts are the WAB path (token projector, 4-layer spatial VideoEncoder, bias projector, training-only VideoHead) plus LoRA adapters on the target LLM
  Tags: speculative-decoding, relaxed-acceptance, world-model, inference-acceleration, libero, simpler-env, openvla, univla, actioncodec, lora, vae-latent, near-contact-failure, autoregressive

MODEL: RedFlow
  Organization: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
  Date: 2026-07-30

  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Conditional flow-matching velocity field v_theta(x_n, n, o_t, l) predicting action chunks of length K=5, post-trained with the Adaptive Redirection Objective (quality-weighted attraction + failure suppression + target-guided correction)

    Parameters: ~3B (pi0 backbone; RedFlow adds no new parameters — it is a post-training objective)

MODEL: NAC
  Organization: The University of Texas at Dallas
  Date: 2026-06-19
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21372
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: NACPolicy: autoregressive next-token prediction over NAC's structured discrete code sequence with offset codebooks. The frozen NAC tokenizer maps a continuous action chunk a ∈ R^{B×Ha×Da} to a flattened 1D pseudo-waveform, then a SEANet encoder + Multi-Scale RVQ (2-scale, 1024-entry codebooks, nq quantization stages with per-stage temporal pooling) produces 12 ordered discrete tokens per chunk. The policy predicts these tokens flat with scale-s tokens in [s·Vbins, (s+1)·Vbins); a Vocos-style decoder with ISTFT head recovers continuous actions; first 16 of 32 predicted steps executed in receding horizon.
    Backbone: SEANet-style fully convolutional 1D encoder (~63M params total for NAC tokenizer)
    LLM: Causal Transformer policy (d=256, 4 layers, 4 heads) — NACPolicy autoregressive BC head trained from scratch with observation/language conditioning
    Parameters: ~63M (NAC tokenizer); policy is a small 4-layer causal Transformer (d=256)
  Tags: autoregressive, action_tokenizer, residual_vq, rvqgan, neural_audio_codec, seanet, vocos, istft, adversarial, multi_scale_rvq, libero, real_world
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=49.73): libero_long=49.73, libero_avg=49.73
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'Evaluated only on LIBERO-10 (the LIBERO-Long suite) — the paper does not report LIBERO-Spatial/Object/Goal. Average over 8 seeds with 50 trials per task. Outperforms FAST (38.02), OAT (44.17), VQ-VLA (10.85), Bin (3.95), Diffusion Policy (25.48) on the same protocol.'}
  AI Review Summary: Robot action chunk를 multi-channel 1D pseudo-waveform으로 보고 **neural audio codec (SoundStream/DAC/SNAC 계열의 multi-scale RVQGAN)을 그대로 가져와** action tokenizer로 재활용. 단, **mel-spectrogram loss를 완전히 제거**해야 동작 (mel을 쓰면 LIBERO-10 성공률이 0%로 붕괴) — 인간 청각이 아닌 *kinematic fidelity*에 맞춰 reconstruction은 time-domain MSE

  Date: 2026-06-07

  Venue: arXiv preprint

  Architecture:
    Action Head: Dual-mode output of the underlying VLA: either generate natural-language reasoning then waypoints, or skip language and directly predict waypoints. A lightweight single-hidden-layer MLP gate (hidden dim 128 with dropout, ~0.11M params) operates on the last-layer hidden state at the final token position and outputs a per-frame score p(h); if p(h) > theta=0.66 the model proceeds with language generation, otherwise it produces waypoints directly.

  AI Review Summary: Qwen2-VL (2B/7B/72B)에 FiLM 기반 reasoning injection으로 diffusion action policy를 가이드하여, 39K trajectory 사전학습만으로 970K 기반 OpenVLA를 압도 (multi-task 83.6% vs 39.4%), 102개 미지 물체 zero-shot 63.7%, **82Hz (2B)** 추론 달성.

MODEL: DiMaS
  Organization: ISIR, Sorbonne Université, Paris / Valeo.ai (Pegah Khayatan, Sara Meziane, Jayneel Parekh, Matthieu Cord)
  Date: 2026-07-15
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14280
  Code: https://github.com/pegah-kh/dimas
  Venue: None
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Distribution-Matching Steering (DiMaS): an inference-time representation-steering wrapper for flow-matching VLAs. Extracts residual-stream representations h_{l,p,m} from the action expert at a chosen layer (second-to-last) and all flow-matching denoising steps, pairs each with a continuous behavioral feature (e.g. end-effector speed, vertical displacement). Representations are thresholded by feature quantiles into source D- (feature absent) and target D+ (feature present) distributions. Steering is learned as an optimal-transport map T (Kantorovich W2, solved via low-rank Sinkhorn from the POT package) transporting D- to D+, rather than an additive shift along a fixed linear direction. At test time, a representation is nearest-neighbor projected onto D-, gated by a linear-probe binary classifier g, and interpolated toward the transported point via a knob alpha in [0,1] (default 0.5) to trade off control strength vs. task success.
    Backbone: Model-agnostic wrapper; validated on SmolVLM (SmolVLA, 256M) and PaliGemma-3B (pi0.5) backbones
    LLM: Inherited from the steered base VLA (SmolVLA / pi0.5)
    Parameters: wrapper
  Tags: steering, representation-steering, optimal-transport, flow-matching, inference-time, interpretability, behavioral-control, libero, wrapper, open-source
  Benchmarks:
    libero: libero_object=96.0, libero_spatial=91.0, libero_long=96.0
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'Inference-time steering of a fine-tuned base VLA (pi0.5 / SmolVLA); closed-loop, axis-isolated LIBERO evaluation; 10 tasks x 50 initializations per suite'}
  AI Review Summary: Flow-matching VLA(SmolVLA, π0.5)의 action expert 내부 표현을 고정된 선형 방향으로 이동시키는 대신, 최적 수송(optimal transport)으로 두 표현 **분포**(source D⁻ → target D+) 사이를 수송하는 추론 시점 스티어링 래퍼. 속도·수직 변위 같은 행동 특성을 task 성공률을 유지한 채 제어한다.
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: Ego2Robot
  Organization: AIM3 Lab, Renmin University of China; Qwen Team, Alibaba Inc.; ShanghaiTech University; Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence (BIGAI); Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
  Date: 2026-08-03
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02580
  Code: https://www-ye.github.io/ego2robot_blog/
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) action head conditioned on backbone hidden states H via cross-attention. A context generator compresses H into conditioning features C using 8 learnable query tokens; DiT layers attend to C to predict 32-step action chunks. Trained with a flow-matching objective L = E ||v_theta(a_t, t, c) - (eps - a_0)||^2 on a_t = (1-t)a_0 + t*eps; 8 training steps / 4 Euler inference steps (dt = 1/4). Each action step is 7-dim: 3D position delta, 3D rotation-vector delta, 1D gripper, expressed as camera-frame relative EEF.

    Backbone: Qwen3.5-4B vision-language backbone processing 2-3 RGB views per timestep plus a structured text prompt (embodiment / instruction fields); camera intrinsics K and extrinsics T_wc injected into visual features via mRoPE positional encodings
    LLM: Qwen3.5-4B
    Parameters: ~4B backbone (Qwen3.5-4B) + DiT action head (head size not disclosed)
  Tags: data-synthesis, egocentric-video, human-video, cross-embodiment, retargeting, flow-matching, diffusion-transformer, qwen3.5, robotwin, generalization-benchmark, ood-generalization, real-robot, pretraining, bimanual

MODEL: ERVLA
  Organization: Tsinghua University; Xiaomi Robotics; Peking University; CASIA; HKUST(GZ); Zhejiang University; Fudan University; Wuhan University; Shanghai Innovation Institute
  Date: 2026-06-03
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03784
  Code: https://taoshuaiz.github.io/ERVLA/
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Mixture-of-Transformers: 36-layer Diffusion Transformer (DiT) policy with flow-matching for continuous action generation. DiT conditions only on the knowledge-truncated semantic-prefix KV cache from the VLM (state token, projected state, noisy action tokens with AdaLN-injected diffusion timestep). An auxiliary 'choice policy' branch reads action-query hidden states inside the VLM to predict N=5 candidate action chunks plus scalar scores via L1+score loss; the DiT loss back-propagates through the VLM only via the semantic prefix (knowledge truncation) so synthetic control-query tokens cannot leak into action conditioning.
    Backbone: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (vision-language reasoning backbone)
    LLM: Qwen3-VL-4B
    Parameters: ~4B VLM (Qwen3-VL-4B) + 36-layer DiT action head

MODEL: EvoScene-VLA
  Organization: Australian National University (ANU), University of Queensland, Beijing Normal University
  Date: 2026-05-21
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21862
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Action decoder with recurrent scene prefix. Maintains a persistent action-updated scene state across chunked control calls. At each VLM call: (a) observation slots extract fresh visual evidence per-view; (b) prior slots inherit the scene state from the previous chunk; (c) action decoder jointly denoises the next action chunk AND a compact scene update via flow-matching ('Joint Action-Scene Denoising'). Two training-only auxiliaries: Scene Predictor (supervises future scene-token targets) and Geometric Anchor (two-level: local depth + global 3D foundation model teacher). Both are discarded at deployment.
    Backbone: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (hidden dim D=2048)
    LLM: None
    Parameters: 3B (Qwen2.5-VL-3B backbone)
  Tags: robotwin, scene-memory, chunked-control, flow-matching, qwen2.5-vl, joint-denoising, geometric-anchor

MODEL: FACT
  Organization: Stanford University (IPRL Lab)
  Date: 2026-08-02
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01402
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Flow-matching action expert with AdaRMSNorm timestep conditioning. Two modifications: (1) Logit-Normal (LN) noise schedule during post-training, tau = sigmoid(s*z - m) with m=1.5, s=1, replacing the default Beta(1.5, 1.0) schedule — allocates 6x more gradient signal to tau < 0.2 (the contact-correction regime); (2) time-aware force injection where the mean-pooled current 6-D F/T window modulates the per-layer AdaRMS scale (h_l = (gamma_l(tau) + delta_gamma(f_t)) * RMSNorm(h_{l-1}) + beta_l(tau) + h_{l-1} g_l(tau)) and H=30 past force windows (~2 s) are encoded as prepended tokens.
    Backbone: pi0.5 (primary) and pi0 (transfer experiment); pre-trained VLM prefix + flow-matching action expert (18 layers). All methods fine-tuned with LoRA (~50M trainable params). FACT adds ~2.2M parameters: a shared causal TCN force encoder (~0.2M, 4 dilated blocks, hidden width 64) and an AdaRMS conditioning head (~2.1M, two MLP layers + zero-initialized gamma projection).
    LLM: None
    Parameters: ~2.2M added modules on top of the pi0.5 backbone (vs ~45M for ForceVLA, ~2.1M for TA-VLA)
  Tags: contact-rich-manipulation, force-sensing, force-torque-sensor, flow-matching, noise-schedule, logit-normal, adarmsnorm, timestep-modulation, post-training, failure-analysis, pi0.5-backbone, pi0-backbone, lora, real-robot, franka, insertion, imitation-learning
  Benchmarks:

MODEL: Foresight Residual RL
  Organization: Rutgers University
  Date: 2026-07-17
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.16506
  Code: https://jaysparrow.github.io/foresight-residual-rl
  Venue: IROS 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Residual correction on flow-matching pi0 base: at = pi0(ot) + alpha * residual(ot), alpha=0.1; residual actor is a regression MLP (7D OSC deltas) trained with PPO. Base action generation remains pi0 flow matching with action chunking H=20.
    Backbone: Frozen per-sub-task pi0 base VLA policies (fine-tuned separately per phase). Residual policy: frozen DINOv2-S/14 wrist-view backbone -> CNN (384->12 ch) -> 2-layer LSTM (256 hidden) -> MLP (512->256->128) with separate actor/critic heads (zero-init actor output). Foresight predictor: DINOv2-S/14 CLS tokens from both camera views, fused via self-attention + linear layer + sigmoid head, LoRA (rank 8).
    LLM: PaliGemma-based VLM (inherited from pi0 base policy)
    Parameters: pi0 base + small residual net
  Tags: residual-rl, pi0, flow_matching, foresight-value, long-horizon, contact-rich-assembly, isaac-gym, ppo, dinov2, skill-chaining, simulation, rutgers
  AI Review Summary: 냉동(frozen) VLA(π0) 위에 얹는 잔차(residual) RL이 각 서브태스크의 성공률은 올려도 **연결(composition)** 시에는 이득이 사라지는 실패 모드를 규명하고, 그 원인이 **핸드오프(terminal) 상태 품질의 방치**임을 지적. 각 서브태스크의 희소 성공 보상에 **오프라인 추정 foresight value**(다음 서브태스크 성공 확률)를 곱해 핸드오프 상태를 성형(shaping)하는 **Foresight Residual RL** 제안.   AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: Guided-Action-Flow
  Organization: University College London
  Date: 2026-07-03
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02092
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Frozen SmolVLA reverse-time flow-matching sampler (x_t = t*eps + (1-t)*a, integrate t=1 -> t=0) with a QGF-style value-gradient velocity update. At each denoising step the clean action is estimated as a_hat = x_t - t*v_t, a K=3 MLP critic ensemble is differentiated w.r.t. a_hat, the gradient is norm-clipped (c=1.0) and gated by ensemble disagreement m = max(m_min, exp(-alpha*sigma_Q)), then v_guided = v_t - m*clip(g,c)/beta. Subtraction (not addition) follows from the reverse-time SmolVLA convention. Critic gradients apply only to physical LIBERO action dimensions; padded dimensions are untouched.
    Backbone: Inference-time Q-guided flow sampling wrapper around a frozen SmolVLA policy (official lerobot/smolvla_libero checkpoint via the LeRobot evaluation stack). No new VLA backbone; the base denoiser and language-vision pathway are never updated.
    LLM: Inherits frozen SmolVLA VLM; its text-pathway hidden states (mean-pooled over non-padding task tokens) are reused as task-description features for the critic
    Parameters: SmolVLA base fully frozen; adds only a K=3 ensemble of MLP critics (hidden dim 768, depth 4) over flattened observation features, action chunks, and optional VLM hidden-state task features
  Tags: vla, test-time-steering, inference-time, flow-matching, q-learning, critic-guided, guidance, smolvla-base, frozen-base-policy, ensemble-uncertainty, libero, offline-rl, action-chunking, feasibility-study
  Benchmarks:
    libero: single_task_spatial_seed3000_qgf=82.0, single_task_spatial_seed3000_baseline=68.0, single_task_spatial_seed4000_qgf=86.0, single_task_spatial_seed4000_baseline=82.0, multi_family_validation_qgf=56.0, multi_family_validation_baseline=46.0, multi_family_held_out_qgf=67.5, multi_family_held_out_baseline=65.0
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'Vanilla LIBERO only for QGF claims; LIBERO-Plus and LIBERO-PRO reported solely as frozen-baseline anchors (78.0% spatial subset / 1.0% zero-shot) and named as future expansion targets', 'protocol': 'Single-task: 1 LIBERO spatial task, 50 episodes/seed (seeds 3000/4000). Spatial-only transfer: 60 validation episodes. Multi-family: validation 50 episodes (spatial 5/7/8, object 6/7), locked held-out 40 episodes (spatial 6/9, object 8/9)', 'critic_targets': 'Sparse success-to-go y_i = gamma^(j*-i) (0 if no future success; 1 after first success); episode-level train/validation splits to avoid chunk-level trajectory leakage', 'sensitivity': 'Earlier sweeps showed sensitivity to beta, critic checkpoint selection, and gating; the same mechanism can produce per-episode gains and regressions', 'negative_result': 'Spatial-only multi-task critic failed to transfer: baseline 32/60 vs QGF at most 31/60 on validation; motivated task-description features + multi-family data + disagreement gating'}
  AI Review Summary: Frozen SmolVLA의 reverse-time flow 샘플러에 QGF 스타일 **value-gradient 속도 보정**을 주입하는 inference-time wrapper. 실제 LIBERO 롤아웃의 sparse success-to-go로 학습한 MLP critic 앙상블(K=3)을 클린 액션 추정치 â = x_t − t·v_t에서 미분해 v_guided = v_t − m·clip(g,c)/β로 샘플링 경로를 조정한다. 단일 태스크 68.0→82.0% / 82.0→86.0%, 멀티패밀리 validation 46.0→56.0
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: MiDAS
  Organization: Carnegie Mellon University
  Date: 2026-08-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11363
  Code: https://minimal-data-adaptation.github.io
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Two-stage recipe. Stage I: fine-tune pi0.5 on K demonstrations with the native flow-matching objective (LoRA on the VLM backbone, full action head trained) to obtain pi_base^K. Stage II: freeze pi_base^K and train a lightweight residual actor pi_res_theta(.|s_t, a_base) = tanh(N(mu_theta, sigma^2_theta)) that directly predicts the executed action chunk conditioned on the base policy's proposed chunk, together with a critic ensemble trained by TD learning. Policy improvement follows PA-RL: sample action candidates, take gradient-ascent steps on the Q function, and distill the optimized chunk back into the residual policy.
    Backbone: pi0.5 pre-trained vision-language-action model (frozen after Stage I); VLM backbone provides the state representation for the residual actor and critic
    LLM: pi0.5 VLM backbone (LoRA-adapted during Stage I behavior cloning)
    Parameters: unknown
  Tags: reinforcement_learning, residual_policy, online_rl, offline_to_online, one_shot_adaptation, flow_matching, pi0_5, pa_rl, libero, libero_pro, robocasa, real_robot, bimanual, sample_efficiency
  Benchmarks:
    libero: libero_long=91.2
    real_world: block_placement_bimanual=67.0, knife_and_donut_on_plate=80.0, real_avg=73.5
    robocasa365: robocasa365_partial_avg=89.3
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned', 'real_world': 'fine-tuned', 'robocasa365': 'RoboCasa-365, 3 of 4 evaluated tasks averaged (LoadDishwasher excluded by the authors); K=1 demonstration + autonomous online RL; 50 rollouts per task, mean +/- std over 3 seeds (89.3 +/- 8.7); mobile manipulator, 256x256 cameras, horizons 500-800 steps', 'robocasa': 'fine-tuned'}
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: PanoVLA
  Organization: Beihang University; Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence (BIGAI); Shandong University; Johns Hopkins University; Delta Intelligence
  Date: 2026-08-03
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02257
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Conditional flow matching action expert. Three-expert Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) instantiated from the pi-0.5 dual-expert backbone by inserting a 100M-parameter panorama expert between the VLM expert and the action expert. Fusion interface is the transformer key-value (KV) cache: the VLM expert builds C_vlm from local views + instruction + proprio state, the panorama expert performs joint self-attention over panorama tokens conditioned on C_vlm under a block-wise causal mask to yield C_pano, and the action expert predicts a 32-step continuous action chunk from the concatenated cache [C_vlm; C_pano].
    Backbone: PaliGemma-based VLM (SigLIP for local camera views) + MTPano panoramic encoder (segmentation and depth branch features concatenated, adaptive average pooling + MLP token adapter)
    LLM: Gemma-2B (frozen during training)
    Parameters: pi-0.5 backbone (Gemma-2B LLM) + 100M panorama expert + pretrained MTPano encoder; total not stated in paper
  Tags: mobile-manipulation, panorama, bimanual, whole-body-teleoperation, flow-matching, mixture-of-transformers, pi0.5, real-world, equirectangular, VR-teleoperation
  Benchmarks:
    real_world: move_pen_scr=95.6, move_pen_sr=86.7, move_block_scr=96.7, move_block_sr=93.3, open_curtain_scr=88.3, open_curtain_sr=66.7, wipe_table_scr=84.4, wipe_table_sr=46.7, avg_stage_completion_rate=91.3, real_world_avg=73.4

MODEL: QPILOTS
  Organization: University of Toronto; Vector Institute; LG Electronics
  Date: 2026-06-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14801
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Inference-time Q-steered flow matching. The base velocity field v_theta(x_t, t, s) is left unchanged; at every Euler step the integrator is augmented with a critic-gradient drift v_steered = v_theta + alpha * g_t where g_t = (||v_theta|| / (||grad V_t|| + eps)) * grad V_t(x_t; s), and V_t is the log-tilt potential of the KL-regularized target pi* propto pi_beta * exp(tau * Qbar). Two variants: QPILOTS-U evaluates the critic gradient at the Tweedie-denoised endpoint x_hat_1 = x_t + (1-t) v_theta (single forward-backward pass through critic, no extra training); QPILOTS-M draws N=4 differentiable posterior samples from a learned Meta Flow Map X_hat_{0,1}(eps; t, x_t, s) and uses an MFM-G log-sum-exp Monte Carlo estimator of the posterior-tilt gradient.
    Backbone: Inference-time Q-steering wrapper applied on top of a frozen flow-matching VLA. For VLA experiments, the base flow is the public pi0.5-LIBERO checkpoint of Black et al. (3B params, PaliGemma-class VLM + flow-matching action expert, finetuned on LIBERO-40). For from-scratch OGBench experiments, a flow-matching policy with critic ensemble is co-trained.
    LLM: Inherits base policy's VLM (pi0.5 = PaliGemma-class for the VLA setting; not modified)
    Parameters: 3B (frozen pi0.5 base in LIBERO setting); QPILOTS adds zero parameters for U variant and a transformer-style MFM (auxiliary network matching pi0.5's action expert depth/heads, init from pi0.5 weights) for the M variant; no updates to base flow weights
  Tags: vla, test-time-steering, inference-time, flow-matching, q-learning, rl-finetuning, offline-to-online-rl, tweedie-guidance, meta-flow-map, posterior-sampling, classifier-guidance, pi0.5-base, libero-90, ogbench, frozen-base-policy, sarsa, critic-guided, kl-regularized-policy-improvement
  Benchmarks:
    ogbench: aggregate_50_tasks_online_success_rate=90.0, aggregate_50_tasks_offline_success_rate=48.0, qpilots_u_aggregate_online=89.0, qpilots_u_aggregate_offline=44.0, humanoid_large_navigate_online=60.0, cube_quadruple_play_online=79.0, puzzle_4x4_play_sparse_online=100.0, scene_play_sparse_online=99.0
    latency_analysis: pi0_5_baseline_ms_per_step=112.7, qpilots_u_ms_per_step=114.1, qpilots_u_overhead_x=1.04, qpilots_m_ms_per_step=240.1, qpilots_m_overhead_x=2.14, best_of_5_ms_per_step=127.2, best_of_20_ms_per_step=158.0, qpilots_u_sr_pct=83.3, qpilots_m_sr_pct=88.5, pi0_5_sr_pct=19.2
    libero_90: task_26_put_wine_bottle_in_bottom_drawer=43.0, task_31_put_black_bowl_on_top_of_cabinet=55.0, task_38_put_right_moka_pot_on_stove=91.0, task_59_pick_tomato_sauce_into_tray=82.0, task_60_pick_black_bowl_left_into_tray=99.0, task_64_stack_right_bowl_on_left_into_tray=89.0, libero_90_6task_mean=76.5
  Eval Conditions: {'ogbench': 'OGBench single-task; 1e6 offline + 5e5 online steps; 8 seeds; per-domain (H, gamma, rho) follows Li & Levine 2026.', 'libero_90': 'Frozen pi0.5-LIBERO base flow + per-task SARSA critic learned online (5e5 steps, 5 seeds) + QPILOTS-U/M inference-time steering. 6 LIBERO-90 tasks where pi0.5 zero-shot SR is 5-50%. Action chunking H=10, gamma=0.99, rho=0.5. alpha per Table 4.', 'libero': 'LIBERO-90 subset (6 tasks: 26/31/38/59/60/64). Frozen pi0.5-LIBERO base; SARSA online critic; 5 seeds; EMA time-weighted alpha=0.99 smoothing along training axis before averaging across seeds.', 'steering_coef_sensitivity': 'Most OGBench domains peak at alpha in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5} and degrade gracefully; puzzle-4x4-play-sparse requires alpha=2.0 (only domain with sharp peak).', 'value_learning_ablation': 'On LIBERO-90 task 64, SARSA reaches 90% SR at 5e5 steps, outperforming IQL/FQL (unstable under non-stationary replay) and Monte-Carlo (dominated by early-training negative returns).', 'theoretical_guarantee': 'Idealized QPILOTS-M with exact posterior samples and unrescaled sigma_t^2/2 drift satisfies W2(p_hat_1, pi*) <= C(1/sqrt(K) + 1/sqrt(N)) and KL <= C(1/K + 1/N) under standard regularity on v_theta, Qbar, the exact posterior sampler, and sigma_t (Appendix B). QPILOTS-U has no formal guarantee — Bayes-optimal only when pi_beta is Gaussian.'}
  AI Review Summary: Flow-matching VLA를 한 줄도 수정하지 않고, Euler 적분기 매 스텝마다 **Tweedie 디노이즈된 깨끗한 액션 위에서 평가한 Q-gradient**를 drift에 더해 KL-정규화 최적 정책 π* ∝ π_β · exp(τ Q̄)에서 샘플링하는 inference-time Q-steering 기법. OGBench 50태스크 online에서 aggregate 90% SR로 BPTT/distillation/fine-tuning 계열을 모두 제치고, 3B π0.5-LIBERO를 frozen 상태로 둔 채 6개 LIBERO
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: ReTouch
  Organization: University of Science and Technology of China; iFLYTEK; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
  Date: 2026-08-03
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01824
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Two parameter-independent 18-layer Transformer Action Experts (hidden width 1024, 8 attention heads) trained with action flow matching. The Hindsight Action Expert (HAE) is a training-only privileged branch conditioned on ground-truth future tactile patch features; the Foresight Action Expert (FAE) is the deployable expert that infers future tactile latents from learnable Tactile Foresight Queries. Alignment at layer l=12 via a 1024->1024->1024 SiLU projector and mean cosine distance (weight 0.1) with stop-gradient on HAE targets. Outputs a 16-step chunk of 18-dim absolute joint-position commands; inference uses 10 explicit-Euler steps from t=1 to 0.
    Backbone: Initialized from a pretrained pi0 checkpoint. Vision input: one wrist-mounted RGB view + two fixed external RGB views, all resized to 224x224 with aspect-ratio-preserving padding and normalized to [-1,1]. Proprioception: 18-dim state (6 UR7e joint positions + 12 XHand joint positions). Tactile input: 5 fingers x 120 three-axis force taxels, with a 10-frame window (9 history + current).
    LLM: pi0 vision-language backbone (VLM), run at 9 Hz with cached semantic context
    Parameters: not stated in paper (pi0-initialized; each Action Expert is an 18-layer Transformer with width 1024)
  Inference: 36 Hz
  Tags: tactile, visuo-tactile, dexterous-manipulation, contact-rich, five-finger-hand, xhand, ur7e, flow-matching, pi0-backbone, action-chunking, asynchronous-inference, closed-loop, tactile-prediction, hindsight-foresight, real-robot, real-world-only

    Action Head: Flow-matching diffusion-transformer (DiT) action decoder consumes Qwen3-VL final-layer features (hidden dim 2560) and predicts continuous action chunks at:t+H-1 over a 50-dim joint+dexterous-hand action space.     Action Head: Autoregressive (or parallel) discrete action-token prediction decoded by a state-aware VQ-VAE action tokenizer. MODEL: SEAM
  Organization: South China University of Technology
  Date: 2026-07-06
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04609
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Frozen pi0.5 flow-matching action expert (H=50 chunk, N=10 Euler ODE steps, K=10 executed actions, overlap L=40) with Velocity-guided Loss Steering (VLS): after each Euler step, the previous chunk's unexecuted tail is extended by repeating its last action into an aligned prior a_al; a time-interpolated target r_{i+1} = (1-t_{i+1}) * a_al[1:M] defines a closed-form quadratic-loss gradient g = -2(x_tilde[1:M] - r), applied as x[1:M] = x_tilde[1:M] + lambda*(1-t_{i+1})*g on the guided overlap window M=20 only, without backpropagating through the policy network.
    Backbone: Training-free inference-time wrapper around a frozen flow-matching VLA; evaluated on pi0.5 (PaliGemma-2B VLM with SigLIP vision encoder + Gemma-300M action expert), fine-tuned on LIBERO-10. No new backbone; the base policy is never updated.
    LLM: Inherits frozen pi0.5 PaliGemma-2B vision-language model
    Parameters: pi0.5 base fully frozen (PaliGemma-2B + Gemma-300M action expert); SEAM adds no parameters, no auxiliary networks, no retraining
  Tags: vla, inference-time, training-free, flow-matching, action-chunking, chunk-boundary-smoothing, guidance, test-time-steering, pi0.5-base, frozen-base-policy, motion-smoothness, libero

MODEL: Semantic-3DGS-VLA
  Organization: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); Midea Group
  Date: 2026-08-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10756
  Code: None
  Venue: ACM MM 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: ScaleDP diffusion action expert (DexVLA plug-in diffusion expert). Semantic-3DGS cues are fused into a single conditioning vector and injected only into the final five diffusion blocks B = {L-4, L-3, L-2, L-1, L} via zero-initialized projections and lightweight MLP adapters (h_l <- h_l + A_l(Proj(z_sem))). The cue set is a language-conditioned target heatmap H_t, an obstacle-aware occupancy cue O_t, a three-channel PCA rendering P_t of the distilled per-Gaussian semantic field, and a target-relative pose vector r_t = [p_obj^B, h_t] in R^4; the image cues are concatenated with the RGB observation and encoded to z_img in R^128, the pose cue to z_pose in R^128, and their sum is z_sem. The VLM backbone and all pretrained diffusion blocks stay frozen; only the semantic encoder, projection layers, late-block adapters and the embodiment-specific action head are trained. Action chunk length 15, two recent observation frames, arm joint targets (including gripper) streamed at 30 Hz over ROS.

    Backbone: DexVLA-style policy with a Qwen2-VL vision-language backbone; four actively acquired wrist-camera RGB views feed a local Semantic-3DGS field whose geometry is initialized by a pretrained VGGT model and whose per-Gaussian semantics are distilled from CLIP and DINOv2 with SAM mask-aware pooling

MODEL: SiMDex
  Organization: The University of Tokyo; ByteDance Seed; The University of Hong Kong; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Tsinghua University

  Code: https://lin-nie.github.io/SiMDex/
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Flow-matching action decoder predicting an action chunk a_{t:t+H} in R^{H x 88} over horizon H = 30; 88-dim action space = 42 morphology-agnostic shared dims (left/right wrist 6D deltas + 5 wrist-local fingertip positions per hand) + 46 robot-specific arm/hand joint dims. Human samples are supervised only on the 42 shared dims via a binary mask m in {0,1}^88; robot samples on all 88.
    Backbone: GR-Dexter [47] base model: a pi0-like flow-matching VLA for bimanual dexterous manipulation (vision-language backbone encodes image I_t and instruction l)
    LLM: vision-language backbone of GR-Dexter (not further specified in the SiMDex paper)
    Parameters: not disclosed
  Tags: data-mining, data-curation, egocentric-video, cross-embodiment, dexterous-hands, bimanual, flow-matching, retrieval, egodex, post-training, real-robot, gr-dexter

MODEL: SpikeVLA
  Organization: Tongji University / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / Waytous
  Date: 2026-06-26
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.27807
  Code: None
  Venue: ICML 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Hierarchical: Spike-L generates discrete navigation commands; Spike-A, a fully spiking MLP action policy (Laplacian-kernel population coding + soft-reset IF neurons, spike-rate decoding to continuous actions), executes low-level quadruped control, trained with PPO via surrogate-gradient spatiotemporal backpropagation
    Backbone: SpikeSigLIP — SigLIPv2 ViT (27 transformer blocks) converted to a spiking vision encoder via training-free ANN-to-SNN differential coding; differential spiking neurons for linear layers and differential graded units for nonlinear ops (LayerNorm, GELU, Softmax, attention products)
    LLM: Spike-L — LLaMA-8B-based multimodal spiking LLM (SFT on real video + simulated navigation + auxiliary nav + VQA data), spike encoding with Integrate-and-Fire neurons, multi-level spike tokens (L-step merge), and differential temporal sparsity allocation (informative channels get longer spiking horizons)
    Parameters: 8B
  Tags: spiking-neural-network, neuromorphic, energy-efficient, navigation, vln-ce, legged-robot, hierarchical, ann-to-snn, population-coding, 8B, icml-2026
  AI Review Summary: SigLIPv2 → SpikeSigLIP(훈련 불필요 ANN-to-SNN 변환), LLaMA-8B → 멀티모달 스파이킹 LLM, PPO 학습 완전 스파이킹 액션 정책까지 VLA의 세 구성요소를 모두 스파이킹 신경망(SNN)으로 대체한 **최초의 spiking VLA** 아키텍처. R2R-CE Val-Unseen에서 NaVILA 수준의 내비게이션 성능(SR 53.3 vs 53.9)을 유지하면서 이론적 에너지 소비를 141.25 J → 49.09 J(약 34%), GPU 메모리를 16.1 GB → 6.2 GB로 절감한 ICML 2026

MODEL: Temporal-GRPO
  Organization: Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
  Date: 2026-08-13
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13026
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Outcome-driven GRPO post-training with stage-conditioned temporal credit assignment. An ordered sequence of detectable task stages m1 -> ... -> mK is generated from the task instruction and initial observation by a frozen RynnBrain-4B embodied planner plus a Stage Compiler; a relation detector aligns each rollout with stage action intervals B_i,k = (T_i,k-1, T_i,k]; group-relative advantages are computed only over rollouts sharing the prerequisite stage (entered-stage gating V_i,k) and assigned solely to the corresponding interval, giving a piecewise temporal advantage A_i,t inside the standard clipped GRPO objective.
    Backbone: None
    LLM: None
    Parameters: 7B (OpenVLA-OFT policy; frozen RynnBrain-4B used only for stage generation during post-training)
  Tags: RL, GRPO, reinforcement-learning, post-training, credit-assignment, long-horizon, robotwin, libero, openvla-oft
  Benchmarks:
    libero: libero_long=99.1
    robotwin_v2 (avg=75.8): short_horizon=73.2, medium_horizon=79.0, long_and_extra_long_horizon=75.2, robotwin_v2_avg=75.8
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'LIBERO-Long only; controlled credit-assignment analysis and ablations; 3 seeds', 'robotwin_v2': 'RL post-training on RoboTwin 2.0 tasks; matched interaction budgets; 3 seeds'}
  AI Review Summary: GRPO 기반 VLA post-training에서 rollout 하나의 스칼라 advantage가 궤적 전체 액션에 그대로 broadcast되는 **trajectory-level credit aliasing** 문제를 지적하고, 탐지 가능한 **ordered task stage** 단위로 비교군과 credit 구간을 재구성. RoboTwin 2.0 macro avg **75.8%** (SimpleVLA-RL 68.8 대비 +7.0pp), LIBERO-Long **99.1%** 달성.

MODEL: UniT
  Organization: XPeng Robotics / Tsinghua University / The University of Hong Kong
  Date: 2026-04-21
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19734
  Code: https://xpeng-robotics.github.io/unit/
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Hybrid two-stage. (1) UniT Token Prediction: learnable queries q_t appended to the VLM sequence; VLM predicts discrete UniT codes c_t = UniT(o_t, o_{t+k}, a_{t:t+k}, s_t) via parallel cross-entropy classification (not causal next-token AR). (2) Flow-Matching action head V_θ on action chunks A_t = [a_t,...,a_{t+H-1}], τ ∈ U[0,1], interpolated path A^τ_t = τA_t + (1−τ)ε; trained with L_fm = E[||V_θ(A^τ_t | x_t, Enc(o_t), τ) − (A_t − ε)||²]. Total: L_VLA = L_token + λ_fm·L_fm.
    Backbone: frozen DINOv2 (visual branch acts as inverse-dynamics model anchor)
    LLM: Qwen2.5-VL (used as VL backbone within the GR00T n1.5 framework)
    Parameters: not stated in paper
  Tags: latent-action, cross-embodiment, humanoid, human-video, world-model, hybrid, flow-matching
  Benchmarks:
    robocasa (avg=66.0): robocasa_gr1_pick_place=67.3, robocasa_gr1_articulated=64.7
    real_world: iron_pick_and_place=78.0, iron_pouring=75.0
  Eval Conditions: {'robocasa': 'Full training data (24×1000 trajs); VLA-UniT (Qwen2.5-VL)', 'real_world': 'IRON-R01-1.11 humanoid; few-shot robot data + EgoDex human co-training'}
  AI Review Summary: Human egocentric video와 humanoid action을 "visual consequence"를 공통 anchor로 삼아 **embodiment-agnostic discrete latent space**로 통합하는, tri-branch cross-reconstruction 기반의 통합 physical language tokenizer.

MODEL: ValueFormer
  Organization: Chef Robotics
  Date: 2026-08-03
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02958
  Code: None
  Venue: arXiv preprint
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: No action head. ValueFormer emits two per-frame scalars from one forward pass: a smooth Monte Carlo value V_mc (3-layer MLP 256->512->256->1, sigmoid) for advantage estimation, and a sharp binary value V_bin (2-layer MLP 256->128->1, sigmoid) for online mistake detection. Actions are produced by the underlying pi0.5 flow-matching policy, which ValueFormer never modifies at inference; the critic influences the policy only through per-frame post-training loss weights.
    Backbone: Frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 at 518x518, applied independently to six views per frame (cam_high, cam_left_wrist, cam_right_wrist plus a cam_high gripper ROI crop and two wrist-gripper ROI crops). Only the CLS token per view is kept, so one frame yields a 6 x 1024 = 6144-dim descriptor. A ViT-B/16 224px variant and a legacy four-view (4096-dim) build are also supported; the four-view build is the substrate for the label-shape ablation.
    LLM: None. ValueFormer is a policy-agnostic critic and contains no language model; the supervised policy is a pi0.5-family VLA that remains unchanged.
    Parameters: 3,459,586 trainable (vision projection 1,573,120; state projection 3,840; time projection 768; positional embedding 4,096; 2-layer 4-head causal transformer 1,579,520; final LayerNorm 512; V_mc head 264,705; V_bin head 33,025). DINOv3 ViT-L/16 encoder frozen. Roughly 0.1% of the ~3.3B pi0-family policy it supervises.
  Inference: 2.0 Hz
  Tags: vla, value-function, critic, policy-agnostic, causal-transformer, dinov3, frozen-backbone, monte-carlo-return, stage-aware-labeling, failure-detection, runtime-monitoring, human-in-the-loop, intervention-weighted-regression, advantage-weighted-regression, post-training-reweighting, real-robot, bimanual-manipulation, pi0.5-base, semi-autonomous, deployment-optimization

    Action Head: Flow-matching trajectory decoder (Conditional Flow Matching, inspired by pi0) over 24 fixed learnable trajectory queries Q_traj in R^{24xd}; each query decodes one future step as (longitudinal acceleration a_lon, yaw change delta-psi), giving u_t in R^{24x2} (x1 = vec(u_t) in R^48). SECTION 3: BENCHMARK DEFINITIONS
================================================================================

LIBERO: 4 manipulation suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, Long-horizon)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.
  Primary ranking metric for VLA-Tracker.

CALVIN: Long-horizon language-conditioned manipulation (ABC→D setting)
  Score: Average number of tasks completed in sequence (0-5). Higher is better.

SimplerEnv: Sim-to-real transfer evaluation
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RoboTwin v1/v2: Bimanual dual-arm manipulation (50+ tasks)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RLBench: Diverse manipulation tasks (18 tasks)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RoboCasa: Home robot manipulation tasks
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.
